__doc__: OPT-02-C1.2 SEO source-unification fixture. Simulates the public rows an anonymous visitor reads from Supabase. Every record name is deliberately UNIQUE and absent from the bundled seeds (src/data.ts, src/defaultState.ts, src/siteContent.ts) so a test can prove the static SEO output tracks THIS data and never the seeds. Rows are in snake_case exactly as PostgREST returns them. Some rows are intentionally incomplete/draft so filtering can be proven. Consumed by scripts/seo-source.test.ts (mock PostgREST server) and scripts/seo-prerender.test.ts (SEO_CONTENT_FIXTURE subprocess).
